thread:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026.03.17 -> inference-eu. Observed error rate spike in canary (5xx), traffic bleed ~18% to canary. Logs: /links/logs/4387654321 :eyes:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: PD#INC-8821 — SLO: error_rate_eu > 1% for 5m. Paging on-call.
alice: I’m oncall, pinging infra. Can we cut canary traffic to 0% and flip the flag?
raj: +1, sounds like routing misconfig. If we can flip feature flag ff.route.europe to stable, do it.
megan: Agree. Also prepare manual rollback if flip doesn’t stabilize. I’ll open the rollback window.
sre-luis: I can do traffic siphon and drain canary nodes. Command: `redwoodctl traffic set --service inference-eu --canary 0` then `redwoodctl drain --selector canary=true --grace 30s`
alice: Running `redwoodctl traffic set --service inference-eu --canary 0` now...
alice: ✅ command accepted, routing change in progress. Watching metrics.
product-beth: Customer impact: EU interactive customers saw increased errors starting ~4387654000, approx 100 distinct sessions affected in last 3m. Notified support team to triage open incidents.
raj: If traffic flip doesn't reduce 5xx within 2m, we should rollback release/2026.03.17 -> previous tag v2.4.8. Prepare rollback runbook: `redwoodctl rollout revert --service inference-eu --to v2.4.8 --force`
megan: I’ve drafted a short status note for SRE channel and set SEV2 if impact continues.
incident-bot: Update: error_rate_eu has dropped to 0.6% after routing change (2m). Continuing to monitor for 10m.
sre-luis: Still seeing elevated latency on a subset of canary hosts; drain is at 70%. Suggest keep rollback ready.
alice: Agree. Starting smoke tests against stable traffic path: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://eu.api.redwood.ai/health`
alice: health -> 200, basic inference smoke looks normal on a few test requests.
product-beth: Support queue still showing some 500s from older requests, might be retries hitting canary proxy. Will add note to support playbook to throttle retries.
raj: Can we confirm no customer-visible regressions after flip? Run small A/B checks for key customers.
megan: I’ll coordinate with SEs for manual verification for priority customers. @product-beth can you send the list?
product-beth: Sending list in DM, will update after priority checks.
incident-bot: Alert state -> WARNING -> no longer paged. Keep monitoring for 15m.
sre-luis: Drain completed. Canary hosts spun down. No rollout revert executed.
alice: Verified 15m window: error_rate_eu avg 0.45%, no new 5xx bursts. I’ll mark the immediate mitigation as successful.
megan: Handoff: I’ll lead post-incident cleanup and coordinate with runtime team for root-cause. Scheduling 1hr sync in #incidents-postmortem at 15:00 UTC.
product-beth: Customer comms: Drafted a short note for affected EU customers, will only send if we see further recurrence.
raj: Action items: 1) Add automated guard to stop canary traffic if bleed > 10% in first 5m. 2) Add a pre-rollout traffic leak check to routing controller. 3) Postmortem runbook updates.
alice: Thanks team. Closing active pager. Will follow up in postmortem channel with logs and timeline. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident closed (temporary mitigation) — ticket INC-8821 created and linked to PM-3492 for follow-up.
